file_write_confinement.text: A sandboxed run cannot create, modify or delete files outside its scratch directory

network_egress_isolation.text: A sandboxed run cannot send data to loopback/network endpoints (TCP, UDP, raw libc)

descendant_confinement.text: Child and detached background processes inherit the confinement

database_scope_enforcement.text: A database write that exceeds its effect contract is not committed

connector_fail_closed.text: A protected connector call does not proceed while the collector is unreachable

unsupported_do_not_claim: credential reads are monitored (CRED-READ has no independent observation channel)
process creation is prevented or reliably observed (PROC-SPAWN-*)
